results.title: Document shows RAF fired anti-riot gun twice during Jantar Mantar protest on DCP-rank officer's directive
results.description: As per the document, a Deputy Commandant from an RAF battalion informed the Duty Officer's room that his unit was deployed at Zone-1 of Jantar Mantar alongside a DCP-rank IPS officer during the protest.

results.title: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani promises 30% cheaper meat and essentials, unveils discounted grocery plan
results.description: Mayor Mamdani announced five city-run grocery stores offering 30% discounts on essentials to fight food insecurity in NYC, details inside.
